name: specclaw-mod
description: Claude Code mod for specclaw: a changes pane, a band above the prompt, a status line entry and a propose-gate guard on edits.

gate.title: Propose gate
gate.description: block: deny Edit, Write and NotebookEdit on project files outside .specclaw/ and .git/ (a change's state.json included) until a change is approved. warn: allow and show a toast. off: no check.
